suppress.notes: CVE-2026-66299 affects Tomcat's example WebSocket chat application. Spring Boot's embedded Tomcat dependencies do not ship the examples web application. Remove this suppression after upgrading to the first fixed Tomcat 10.1.x release (10.1.58+).

Dependency-Check identifies Guava metadata embedded in Error Prone's compiler-only dataflow artifact. It is not part of the runtime application, and current Error Prone releases still use dataflow-errorprone 3.41.0-eisop1. Re-evaluate when that artifact updates.
